items.stem: Tom is a staff member of a drink store.

parts.label: a
parts.text: When Tom takes orders from customers, he has to input the ordered drink and the corresponding amount of each ordered drink. Suggest 2 validation checks to reduce input errors.      (2 marks)

parts.label: b
parts.text:
Now, the drink store would like to install kiosks to reduce the number of staff members. Ben suggests adding “+” and “-“ buttons on the user interface to determine the number of drinks to be ordered.
Give 2 reasons to support Ben.(2 marks)

parts.label: c
parts.text:
The kiosk has to include:
Selection of different categories (Tea latte, fruit tea, milk tea)
Selection of different drinks with images
“+” and “-“ buttons to modify the number of drinks
Design the user interface for the kiosk.(4 marks)

parts.label: d
parts.text: A checkout page is designed for the kiosk. It shows all the drinks ordered by the user. Suggest a reason for adding the checkout page. (1 mark)

parts.label: e
parts.text:
To collect feedback from customers, the kiosk will show the following screen after an order is complete.
Give 2 types of data validation used in the screen above. (2 marks)_______________________________________________________________________________
[--Answer:
(a) Ordered drink: Fixed value check/presence check
Amount: Type check/ range check
(b) Data validation: It ensures the data type is valid.
User-friendliness: It increases efficiency of input.(c)
(d) To ensure the customer has not ordered the wrong drinks.
(e) Range check and type check.
--]
